CreateApp.description_en: Creates a whiteboard application. You can set the application name and obtain the AppID at the same time
CreateApp.description_zh: 创建白板应用，设置应用名的同时获取AppID

CreateWhiteBoard.description_en: Creates a whiteboard document and retrieves the document identifier (DocKey)
CreateWhiteBoard.description_zh: 创建白板文档，获取白板文档标识DocKey

DescribeApps.description_en: Queries whiteboard application information under a cloud account by using paged query. Paging is supported
DescribeApps.description_zh: 分页查询云账号下的白板应用信息

DescribeWhiteBoardRecordings.description_en: Queries the recording list and operation sequences of a whiteboard by paging
DescribeWhiteBoardRecordings.description_zh: 分页查询白板所开启的录制列表和操作序列

DescribeWhiteBoards.description_en: Queries whiteboard document information under a specified AppID by paging
DescribeWhiteBoards.description_zh: 分页查询某AppID下的白板文档信息

OpenWhiteBoard.description_en: Opens an existing whiteboard document and retrieves the connection information for the whiteboard document
OpenWhiteBoard.description_zh: 打开已有白板文档，获取白板文档连接信息

PauseWhiteBoardRecording.description_en: Pauses the recording of whiteboard operation sequences
PauseWhiteBoardRecording.description_zh: 暂停白板操作序列录制

RefreshUsersPermissions.description_en: Refreshes the permission cache of whiteboard document users. When a user accesses the whiteboard again, the user permissions are confirmed through a callback
RefreshUsersPermissions.description_zh: 刷新白板文档用户的权限缓存，当用户再次访问白板时，通过回调确认用户权限

ResumeWhiteBoardRecording.description_en: Resumes whiteboard operation sequence recording from a paused state
ResumeWhiteBoardRecording.description_zh: 恢复白板（录制暂停中）操作序列录制

SetAppCallbackType.description_en: Sets the callback type for a whiteboard application
SetAppCallbackType.description_zh: 设置白板应用的回调类型

SetAppCallbackUrl.description_en: Sets the callback URL and callback authentication code for a whiteboard application
SetAppCallbackUrl.description_zh: 为白板应用设置回调服务地址及回调鉴权码

SetAppDomainNames.description_en: Sets the list of authorized domain names for a whiteboard application, which are the domain names that need to access the whiteboard service
SetAppDomainNames.description_zh: 为白板应用设置合法域名列表，即使用中需要访问白板服务的域名列表

SetAppStatus.description_en: Sets the status of a whiteboard application. Valid values: 1 (enabled) and 2 (disabled)
SetAppStatus.description_zh: 为白板应用设置状态，1:启用，2:停用

SetUsersPermissions.description_en: Sets long-term permissions for users of a whiteboard document
SetUsersPermissions.description_zh: 设置白板文档用户的长期权限

StartWhiteBoardRecording.description_en: Starts recording the operation sequence of a whiteboard
StartWhiteBoardRecording.description_zh: 启动白板操作序列录制

StopWhiteBoardRecording.description_en: Stops recording a whiteboard operation sequence
StopWhiteBoardRecording.description_zh: 结束白板操作序列录制
